text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right before the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, a 
piece of news sent shockwaves through the 
racing world—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Therefore, after the upcoming Japan Cup, 
I will enter an extended break.”

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur, murmur, murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Please, watch until the very end.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The moment where I prove I am the 
strongest in history in the greatest race 
in history...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the showdown in the Japan Cup 
against Almond Eye that Loves Only You had 
hoped for was set to become a reality, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"—Daring Tact, this year's Triple Tiara 
umamusume, has also announced her entry 
into the same race."

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"It's already being called the match of 
the century, and fan anticipation is 
soaring, but frankly speaking, what are 
your chances of victory...?!"

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"『I am well aware that every Umamusume in 
the field is formidable. Even so, I will 
win. Because that is who I am.』"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Match of the century, huh.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Oh my— Loves-chan. What a coincidence, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Smartphone Voice
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will definitely win and reflect 
everyone's dreams in my eyes! Please keep 
cheering for me until the very end!’"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "Oops— Sorry about making so much noise."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. ...That was Ai-san's press 
conference just now, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, guess you saw right through me after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Are you feeling lonely after all, 
Lala-san?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well, who knows? ...At the very least, it 
definitely ain't lonely.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...To me, Ai-san was someone who, before 
I even realized it, came from behind and 
overtook me—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"And then, she became crazy strong. 
...That's the kind of image I have."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She's always so competitive, such a hard 
worker, and has such strong convictions—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Once you set your mind to something, you 
see it through. ...I think this 
declaration is very like you, Ai."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪ ...That's something only a classmate 
like Rara-san could do.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"Right. We're from the same generation, 
after all—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She won't get it unless I show her through 
my running. I know all about how she is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
......Lara-san. I'm planning to run in the 
upcoming Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That's where I plan to throw everything I 
have at Ai-san. ...My full, all-out 
running, now that I've gotten stronger.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Heh... ...All to win?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Of course. ...More than that, though, I 
want to show them.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"I'll show what I couldn't at the Victoria 
Mile... my true strength."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Loves-chan, you've changed. You're 
kinda... scarier than before."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: But—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—I wonder how she'll do in the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna show everyone. —Who's truly the 
strongest right now."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"And I'm gonna show a certain sore loser, 
too. By askin', 'Is that really what it 
means to be the strongest?'"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
That's why, Loves-chan. Before the Japan 
Cup, how about we test ourselves against 
each other?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Show me, will ya? —What true strength 
really is.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I gladly accept. Because—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
âBecause I really wanted to show you 
too, Lala-san.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them a different me from last 
year...!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. Right, let's get started...!
